summary_1line: Yudhishthira, anxious over missing Arjuna and Satyaki, sends Bhima to find them; Bhima charges through enemy ranks and confronts Drona blocking his advance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira, tearful and anxious in his chariot amid the chaos of battle, sends Bhima forth while conch blasts echo across the field.
Bhima, armored in black steel flashing with gold, roars and blows his conch as his chariot surges into the Kaurava army.
Drona calmly halts Bhima’s advance and strikes his forehead with an arrow as the two face each other amid the battlefield.
